title: std/transcript@1
description: A speech-recognition hypothesis. Deliberately NOT std/text@1: `text` here REPLACES the previous hypothesis rather than appending to it, because a recogniser re-decodes its whole buffer and hypothesis 3 is not hypothesis 2 plus a suffix. Feeding partials into a consumer that concatenates would corrupt it.

final.description: True when the utterance ended and this is the settled transcript.

replace.description: True (the norm) when this supersedes the previous hypothesis for the same utterance.

utterance.description: Groups the partials of one utterance.
